hand-calculation.derivation: For phi=k*x*cos(beta)-omega*t and x=U*t, phi=-(omega-k*U*cos(beta))*t. Signed encounter frequency is therefore omega-k*U*cos(beta). Deep-water dispersion gives k=omega squared/g. With synthetic g=8 m/s², omega=[2,4] rad/s and U=1 m/s, k=[4/8,16/8]=[0.5,2] 1/m. Exact cardinal cosines [1,0,-1] at beta=[0,pi/2,pi] give rows [2-0.5,2,2+0.5]=[1.5,2,2.5] and [4-2,4,4+2]=[2,4,6] rad/s. At U=0, each row equals its input omega.
hand-calculation.readiness: Arithmetic illustration only; synthetic gravity is not a physical recommendation.
hand-calculation.units: Gravity m/s²; angular frequencies rad/s; speed m/s; headings rad; wave number 1/m; depth m.

numerical-control.source: Specified roundoff criterion for the synthetic hand calculation
numerical-control.display: Worked inputs and frequencies use one decimal place; headings retain exact symbolic radians. Signed differences use scientific notation with one decimal in the mantissa. All comparisons use unrounded values; these bounds concern floating-point roundoff, not engineering uncertainty.

methods.role: Production arithmetic and static review; only wave_number and encounter_frequency are executed.

direction-contract.role: Existing software heading convention: zero is following seas and pi is head seas. External convention alignment is not established.

routes.role: Static interface inventory only; empirical coefficients and standard attributions are not adopted as a design basis.

delegates.role: Static route tracing; no meshing, solver or interaction campaign is executed.

report-checks.role: Independent rational oracle, every displayed value and unit, input preservation, stale calculation rejection, exact rebuilds, links and report structure.

layout.role: Existing self-contained report layout and palette only; numerical answers and empirical assumptions are not reused. SVG coordinates are schematic drawing dimensions, not engineering inputs.
